description: Records that a message or call is feedback about one field worker, as the inbox's staff-feedback menu does: staffId (from read staff_roster), evidence (the words), sourceType message or call with its sourceId, sentiment positive/neutral/negative, and optional clientId, conversationId, occurredOn. When the client has exactly one recent visit it links the visit too. Idempotent per source and worker: a repeat edits the same entry. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: record_staff_feedback_from_source
title: Record staff feedback from a message or call
